name: grocerly-firestore-rules-tests
description: Firestore and Storage Security Rules tests for Grocerly, run against the Firebase Emulator Suite.

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project mae-assignment-grocerly 'vitest run --exclude functions.test.js'
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project mae-assignment-grocerly 'vitest run functions.test.js'
